analyst_view.overall: Atalanta (12th, 14 points, two wins in their last nine league games) host Inter (3rd, 28 points, four wins in five) on Sunday night; Sarri's side won 1-0 at Monza last time but concede too often when opponents overload the flanks, and they also have Conference League games to manage. Atalanta's back line is the big story the numbers can't see: through the week Hien and Kossounou were still in the gym and on individual work and Kristensen was being judged day by day, so Scalvini and Kolasinac are expected in the middle, with Krstovic preferred to Scamacca up front and Raspadori possibly back on the bench (one report). Inter, under Chivu, are expected to start Thuram and Pio Esposito with Lautaro, back in group training after six weeks out, likely only from the bench; Akanji and Zielinski are fit, while Bonny (counted by the numbers) and Stankovic are out. Referee Fabio Maresca (4.8 cards a game) and a lively head-to-head are already in the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals, already trimming Atalanta a little for recent form and the head-to-head and Inter for Bonny's absence. Atalanta are likely without Hien and Kossounou and possibly Kristensen, which the numbers don't know, and Inter's Thuram-Esposito pair with Lautaro to come on should find room against a stand-in back line; no late news changed that, so a mild lean up to about 3.1.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners, already raised for Inter's recent corner count against an Atalanta side that has conceded many. Atalanta's 4-2-3-1 with overlapping full-backs and Inter's wing-backs are their usual way of playing, and a stand-in Atalanta defence is more likely to concede chances than extra corners, so nothing new points either way; about 9.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards and already add Maresca's high rate (+27%, 4.8 a game) and a lively head-to-head (+13%). No suspension threat, feud or change of referee has been reported this week, so I stay at about 4.1.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.8 shots, already lifted 10% for Inter's recent shooting. Atalanta's makeshift centre-backs point up for Inter, but Chivu plans to share minutes between Thuram and Lautaro in a busy month and Lautaro only comes off the bench, so the two roughly cancel; about 28.8.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.3 shots on target. With Scalvini and Kolasinac expected in the middle and Hien, Kossounou and possibly Kristensen missing, which the numbers don't know, Inter's forwards should get cleaner looks than the numbers assume; a small nudge to about 9.6.
